findings.scope: current formal compound question, not broad gender-unspecified conjugator reference
findings.evidence: variant0 addresses Signora Rossi but accepts c’è restato / ci è restato and say is Lei c’è restato; variant1 accepts both genders too
findings.cause: formalLessonForms returns unfiltered forms for ci clitic before essere subject-agreement filtering
findings.proposed: Keep reference alternatives; filter selected formal addressee gender for essere ci constructions and preserve the exact old selected descriptors as history if retired.

findings.scope: source usage sentence only; current reviewed protective frames remain valid
findings.reason: Treccani explicitly licenses protecting grain from humidity; the note forbids a legitimate protective sense involving food.
findings.proposed: Qualify conservare as the usual food-storage/preservation term; allow preservare qualcosa da deterioration/damage.

findings.scope: source example1, Italian-English pair grammatically aligned
findings.evidence: Nessuno può essere privato della libertà senza un processo. / No one can be deprived of liberty without a trial.
findings.reason: The universal claim confuses trial with legally authorized judicial restrictions and exceptional provisional detention; art13 permits restrictions before a trial.
findings.proposed: Use a fictional/person-specific sentence or precise legal-safeguard wording without equating it to a trial.

findings.scope: source example1, not grammar or generated destination frames
findings.evidence: Per il rinnovo del passaporto è necessario recarsi in questura. / To renew your passport you need to go to police headquarters.
findings.reason: Poste’s current primary page explicitly provides Questura or enabled post offices for request/renewal.
findings.proposed: Make this one person’s planned visit rather than a universal requirement.

findings.severity: bounded pedagogy/default recommendation; not declared ungrammatical
findings.evidence: Io ho provvisto alle spese. / Signora Rossi, Lei ha provvisto alle spese?
findings.reason: Treccani says provveduto is nearly exclusive in compound verb tenses and provvisto rare as a verbal form; it does not support falsely rejecting all rare provvisto verb uses.
findings.proposed: Choose provveduto for current common practical-need teaching and output; retain rare valid reference/old descriptor provenance as appropriate.

findings.scope: selected singular-stone simple imperfect frame0; not a rejection of habitual imperfetto or all auxiliary forms
findings.evidence: Un sasso precipitava verso il basso. / A stone used to plunge downward.
findings.reason: Without repeated falling context the same singular stone sounds like an ongoing episode; habitual English introduces an unsupported repeated-event reading. Italian imperfect admits both readings with context.
findings.proposed: Use A stone was plunging downward for an episode, or author explicit repeatable habitual context. Inspect all selected singular frames before retiring their exact prior IDs.

findings.severity: bounded policy-note qualification candidate; current simple examples valid
findings.scope: simple-only policy note, not assessed form exclusion proven here
findings.evidence: Stare + gerundio would shift the viewpoint or suggest a different sense.
findings.reason: Progressive can retain the current-disourse refer-to sense; primary Treccani attests mi sto riferendo to a named matter. Do not turn teaching preference into a blanket grammar verdict.
findings.proposed: Say simple present is the focus of this lesson and that progressive can mark what the speaker is referring to now.

referenceChecks.outcome: Treccani supports perseguo, not an -isc- defect
Treccani explicitly supports both essere and avere; no auxiliary defect inferred
No categorical rassegnamo rejection made; common preferred -iamo spelling noted only, broad variants were not retired
